summary:
Iteration 8 verified all Dashboard/Deposit/Withdraw/WithdrawHistory/Profile/Coupon/Investments UX changes end-to-end + new public /api/settings/public endpoint + telegram_url/welcome_message admin persistence. Backend: pytest 62 tests, 61 passed and 1 flaky-only-in-parallel (TestPaynowBanks::test_user_paynow_banks_returns_curated_list — passes serially, race between the two xdist workers writing paynow_banks_all_enabled). Added 3 new tests under TestPublicSettingsAndTelegram: (1) unauth GET /api/settings/public returns 200 with all 6 keys, (2) admin PUT persists telegram_url + welcome_message and public endpoint reflects them, (3) clearing telegram_url produces empty string in public payload while welcome_message default remains truthy. Frontend E2E (428x900 mobile) as +2348047969299/pass1234 after admin set telegram_url='https://t.me/naijainvest_e2e' + welcome_message='E2E welcome message from admin panel.':
1) Dashboard: welcome-dialog fires on mount with text 'Welcome back, TEST_FE!' + admin welcome_message + welcome-telegram-btn + welcome-close-btn; dialog re-appears on hard refresh (no localStorage suppression). dashboard-telegram-chip href = admin URL. quick-actions-grid uses `grid grid-cols-4 gap-3` with all 4 tiles (quick-deposit-link, quick-redeem-link, quick-withdraw-link, quick-invest-link). 'Recent activity' string absent from DOM. Referral code card still present.
2) Deposit: 3 tiles rendered (instant + 2 payment accounts), instant tile has min-h-[92px]. Since paynow gateway is DISABLED, first payment account (ACCESS BANK) is auto-selected (ring-2 present) — matches spec fallback branch. deposit-pick-method-hint hidden after auto-select. deposit-selected-panel present. deposit-quick-amounts container uses `grid grid-cols-3 gap-2`. All 6 chips (deposit-quick-500/1000/2000/5000/10000/20000) render. Clicking deposit-quick-500 sets amount input to 500.
3) Withdraw: 'Recent withdrawals' string absent. withdraw-history-link present.
4) WithdrawHistory (/withdraw-history): page id present + all 4 status tab testids (whist-tab-all/pending/approved/rejected) + whist-search-input + whist-list.
5) Profile: 0 role=tab elements (History Tabs fully removed). All menu link testids present: profile-link-referrals, -deposit, -deposit-history, -withdraw, -withdraw-history, -bank, -coupon, and profile-logout-button.
6) Coupon (/coupon): coupon-page, coupon-heading, coupon-code-input, coupon-redeem-button, coupon-wallet-balance all present.
7) Investments: exactly 1 [data-testid^='inv-daily-'] element for the Starter Plan showing '+₦10/ day' (200 * 5% = 10). Correct.
8) Referrals: user has 0 referrals so load-more-gen1/2/3 buttons do NOT render (expected — button is conditional on remaining rows). No regression on the Refer & earn page (share links, WhatsApp/Telegram/X/Facebook share chips, Gen1/2/3 tab counts all render).

minor.issue: TestPaynowBanks::test_user_paynow_banks_returns_curated_list fails intermittently (~50%) under pytest-xdist because both workers PUT paynow_banks_all_enabled=true/false against the same singleton settings doc — race. Serial run: 3/3 pass. Recommend either (a) marking these 3 tests non-parallel via @pytest.mark.serial + `pytest -m serial -p no:xdist` group, or (b) fixture that snapshots+restores paynow_banks_all_enabled around each test.

action_items: (minor) Stabilize the TestPaynowBanks race under pytest-xdist — see above.

(spec observation, not a bug) On /deposit, when paynow gateway is disabled, auto-selection lands on the first payment account (ACCESS BANK) instead of deposit-method-instant. This matches the review spec's fallback branch, so recorded here only for main-agent awareness — if the intent is to always default to Instant Pay even when disabled, this needs tweaking.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/settings/public exposes welcome_bonus/min_deposit/min_withdrawal without auth — these are already user-facing values, but confirm none are considered sensitive (they aren't in this codebase).

Dashboard welcome dialog re-firing on every mount is intentional per PRD, but consider a 1-per-session localStorage flag OR a small cooldown to avoid annoying users who navigate away and back within seconds — currently every route change to /dashboard re-opens it.
server.py is 1570 lines — router split still recommended (flagged in iter-6/7).

Deposit.jsx auto-select effect: if paynow is enabled but the API call to fetch settings is slow, there's a brief window where deposit-pick-method-hint could flash before instant is selected. Consider gating the hint on `!settingsLoaded`.
DepositHistory / WithdrawHistory share almost identical row + status-pill + method-tag + accent-color logic — factor into /components/history/HistoryRow.jsx to eliminate duplication.

success_rate.backend: 98.4% (61/62 pytest; 1 flaky-in-parallel unrelated to this iteration)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested testids and behaviors
